newsitem.title: USA: EDS wins contract from U.S. Army Corps.
newsitem.headline: EDS wins contract from U.S. Army Corps.

text.p: Electronic Data Systems Corp (EDS) said on Monday it won a contract to provide remote teleprocessing services to a division which supports the construction activities of the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers.
The one-year contract gave the U.S. Army Corps the option to renew for another four years. If they did, EDS said the contract would be worth about $15 million.
EDS said it would provide software re-engineering services for transition of the Corps' programming, administration and execution system to client/server technology.
It would continue to provide mainframe computer processing services and data network support for the Corps.
